title: SkillsManifest
description: Aeon skills manifest. Generated from skills/ by scripts/build-skills-json (or equivalent). Consumed by mcp-server, a2a-server, and dashboard.

total.description: Total skill count. Must equal skills.length.

install_all.description: Shell command to install every skill.

install_one.description: Shell command template to install one skill (placeholder: <skill-name>).

ManifestSkill.title: ManifestSkill
ManifestSkill.description: A single skill entry as it appears in skills.json. Distinct from dashboard runtime SkillConfig.

description.description: One-line summary used in tool descriptions and listings.

category.description: Top-level grouping. Keep in sync with manifest.categories keys.

schedule.description: Cron expression or "on-demand" or empty string for unscheduled.

var.description: Default value or description for the skill's variable input. Empty if not used.

sha.description: Git short-SHA of the skill's last update.

updated.description: ISO-8601 date of last update, or empty string if unknown.

install.description: Shell command to install this specific skill.
